integrity: Complete theorem, definitions, symmetry block determinants, algebraic gcd proof, distance proof and independently built finite verifier are provided. Finite checks do not prove the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted simple graphs \(\Theta_{2,2,r}\), r even >=2 only. Metric dimension of theta graphs is known previously. Paone--Paone already computed eigenvalue-two signless-Laplacian multiplicity. New statement is all-eigenvalue simplicity and maximum spectral multiplicities, with simultaneous equality classification; no broader theta classification or historical-priority certificate.
title: Even-theta spectral rigidity and simultaneous metric–Laplacian equality
